name: Mist Orb
notes: Mist Orb: wild monsters' moves lose 8 accuracy points against the player, up to 3 times (-24), on top of the walking dodge. Adds 8 to boost_dodge. Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_dodge' (back to 0 each run).
title: MIST ORB
descriptions: WILD MOVES MISS YOU 8% MORE (+16% IN ALL)
